headline: Shiny web platforms make harmonized GWAS, QTL, and expression data queryable
label: Interactive Genomics Web Resources
summary: Harmonized summary statistics and annotations in interactive web apps reduce preprocessing before colocalization and expression analyses.
synthesis: The common thread is pre-harmonized inputs delivered through interactive web access. COLSTATS integrates 1.65M GWAS and QTL summary statistics on hg38 and runs coloc.abf colocalization in a Shiny interface. CaRinDB combines cancer-associated missense mutations with functional predictions, allele frequencies, and residue interaction network parameters in a web database. The Age effect explorer provides a code-free Shiny application for browsing age- and sex-associated expression changes across 54 GTEx v10 tissues, using precomputed linear-model results. The new element across these resources is the coupling of harmonized data with on-demand analysis or visualization, which removes preprocessing steps before users reach results. The items do not report benchmarks, validation, or comparisons against alternative resources, so their suitability for particular research questions remains unassessed.
